dataNotes: Secondary organization pipeline snapshots. These records complement the NHL API, whose public prospects endpoint returned fewer than ten entries for LAK, NYI and TOR.
Rights and league assignments are a secondary snapshot, not a live feed; re-check transactions after 2026-09-28 before treating rights as final.
No ratings, overall, potential, or birth dates are inferred from age or draft rank.

BUF supplement comes from Hockey Scout Data Lab's 2026-27 prospect tracker as of 2026-10-31; only players identified as BUF rights were retained. Ratings and projections from that source are intentionally not imported.
League and development-team context supplemented from Hockey Insights Team Pipeline (2026-09-28 snapshot); secondary data that must be rechecked against current transactions.
